pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Dark contiguous regions display irregular, rounded polygonal geometries with smooth edge gradients. Patches on the lower neck are significantly larger in spatial area compared to the smaller, more fragmented patches on the posterior flank.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Light pelage forms a continuous network of narrow corridors. Junction nodes are clearly visible, primarily as three-way and four-way intersections between patch boundaries.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Mane along the upper neck and shoulder exhibits a low-amplitude, high-frequency jagged silhouette against the background.

other_distinctive_markers: A dark, localized structural protrusion is visible on the posterior dorsal ridge, consistent with the silhouette of an oxpecker bird.
